statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean g → KdVPlan.stage a b f g = KdVPlan.scale (1/6) (KdVPlan.J b f g-KdVPlan.J a f g)
proof:
intro a b f g hab hf hg hzf hzg
have hc (n : ℕ) := yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) hab
  ((yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013).2 n 2 f) ((yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013).2 n 2 g)
  ((yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f).2.2 hzf _) ((yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 g).2.2 hzg _)
funext k
have H := yui_aux_0034 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f g k hf hg
have hlim := intervalIntegral.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
  (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (a := a) (b := b)
  (F := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) k)
  (f := fun t => KdVPlan.B t f g k)
  (fun _ => |(k : ℝ)| * (∑' j : ℤ, ‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖))
  (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => ((hc n).1 k).def'.aestronglyMeasurable))
  (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t _ => H.1 n t)))
  intervalIntegrable_const
  (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t _ => H.2.1 t))
have hl := hlim.const_mul (1/2 : ℂ)
have hr := ((H.2.2 b).sub (H.2.2 a)).const_mul (1/6 : ℂ)
have heq : (fun n : ℕ => (1/2 : ℂ)*(∫ t in a..b, KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) k)) =
  (fun n : ℕ => (1/6 : ℂ)*(KdVPlan.J b (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) k-KdVPlan.J a (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) k)) := by
  funext n
  exact congrFun (hc n).2 k
rw [← heq] at hr
exact tendsto_nhds_unique hl hr
